scope_lock.acceptance: Reconstruct the full approved v16 family from immutable contracts and current source; every capability maps to current code owner, fresh executable evidence, surfaces/docs and final FULL/PARTIAL/MISSING status.

Fresh unit, functional, end-to-end, cross-module, regression, edge/adversarial/fault, randomized, race/concurrency, deterministic, replay/no-lookahead, security and UI/responsive evidence all pass on the closure fingerprint.
Representative 100/500-symbol workloads, Radar, cache/concurrency, goroutine/resource growth and repeated-runtime stress remain within bounded release ceilings with no material regression.

A source-level 15+ year engineering review verifies architecture ownership, maintainability, coupling, complexity, concurrency, failure handling, security, provider efficiency, observability, upgrade safety and developer-proof clarity.

Fresh real-money decision-support scenarios verify freshness/degradation truth, event/catalyst/liquidity risk, contradictions, Radar quality, community/news separation, no false confidence and no execution boundary drift.
Every retained dataset has a valid owner/consumer/retention reason; orphan/duplicate/dead source and unjustified release debris are removed or explicitly retained; cleanup is behavior-preserving.
Review v16 challenges/root causes/fixes/effectiveness and update Roadmap, Build Plan, Build Process, Delivery Process and Release Learning so recurring friction is generalized rather than repeated.
User, Developer, Limitations, README, architecture, release learning, scope matrix and traceability agree with the actual final v16 product and contain no stale current-state semantics.
Canonical De-Pulse.app identity, settings/watchlists/API credentials continuity, native package truth, exact-source clean extraction, provenance and SHA-manifest-last rules remain proven.

v17 is authorized only when all blocking closure evidence is green, no unresolved materially misleading real-money defect remains, performance/source health are acceptable and all PARTIAL/MISSING scope is fixed or explicitly dispositioned by owner approval.
